end.summary:
Discussed how diversity can include different festivals and shared celebrations.
Practised respectful ways to acknowledge another festival’s importance.
Recalled Pongal, Makar Sankranti, Lohri, and Uttarayan.
Connected shared values with celebrating together; teach-back was not passed.
Lesson ended when Riya asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Riya practised describing diversity through festivals and tried a respectful sentence about another person’s celebration. They recalled several harvest festivals and linked Lohri with gathering, music, and celebration. At home, you can ask them to name two festivals and one value they share, such as joy, gratitude, or togetherness.
